properties.name: A budget says how its contributions compose (sum or path) and its verdict follows the declaration; budget_report with no constraint_id reports every budget
properties.rationale:
THE CAUSE (live design: fact:root-cause-a-latency-budget-with-parallel-branches-is-judged-on-the-sum-while-its-worst-path-is-computed-beside-it-2026-09-29): the path rollup was ALREADY computed (worst_path_total 33 for the owner's write path) but the verdict was hard-wired to the plain sum (46, `exceeded` against 40), and a Constraint could not say which rollup its quantity is. Fixed at the reader, for EVERY reader: the verdict, the closure leg's margin and the KPP breach now read one judged rollup, so no reader is left comparing the number the verdict ignored. I17's cause (fact:root-cause-budget-report-reads-one-budget-and-its-refusal-never-names-the-all-budgets-sweep-2026-09-29): a per-item reader with the design-wide sweep built inside a different report with a thinner answer — now the same tool answers both. Both facts live only in the live design, so they are named here, not linked.

THE OPTION CHOSEN from dec:idea-a-constraint-says-how-its-quantity-composes (left open; the requirement settled the question): (a) DECLARED BY THE AUTHOR, with absent meaning nobody said — the verdict keeps the sum and the report names the path total it did not read. WHY THE OTHERS LOST: (b) inference from the unit silently changes verdicts, because the same unit composes both ways; (c) gating on the path whenever one exists under-counts a mass budget whose parts happen to depend on each other — the dangerous direction for a maximum; (d) an instruction alone leaves the false `exceeded` in place; (e) finer contributors multiplies nodes and calls, the very cost the same report measured. `max` was NOT added: parallel branches taking the max IS the path rollup, and no case needed a third.

HONESTY RULES KEPT: a `path` budget reaches no numeric verdict (incomplete, with the reason) when no DEPENDS_ON joins its contributors, when they form a cycle, or when its direction is minimum — reading unjoined parts as parallel would take the largest alone and pass a maximum on a number nobody established. An unstated contributor leaves a path verdict open unless the stated path already exceeds, because an unknown can only make a path heavier.

FAILING FIRST, OBSERVED: tests/a_budget_says_how_it_composes.rs (7 tests) run on a clean origin/main build (42259ba) under the shared build lock — 7 of 7 FAILED (unknown field `composition`; budget_report without constraint_id refused; no judged_on/composition_note; constrains silent on DEPENDS_ON). After the fix: 7/7 pass; the core tests (10 new, budget 15, kpp 12) pass; the route test from #625 updated (the refusal it pinned no longer exists — the form replaces it).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Two reports from the dev_reflow2 hub's two-agent exercise (live design: art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, items I18 and I17), delivered as Anthony's accepted requirement req:a-budget-says-whether-its-parts-add-up-or-run-along-a-path (2026-09-29, "go with the 7 ideas you'd promote"). A Constraint now declares `composition` (sum | path); budget_report's verdict reads the declared rollup and says which (judged_on, judged_total, composition_note); closure's budgets leg and the KPP breach read the same judged rollup; with no constraint_id, budget_report reports every budget, bounded.
